summary: Ryan Specialty Holdings filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, reporting Q3 fiscal results and declaring a regular quarterly dividend of $0.13 per share on Class A common stock, payable May 26, 2026 to holders of record May 12, 2026. The dividend is a capital return event. The board approved this payment, with no special advisors named. The press release is furnished under Item 2.02. What to watch: future dividend patterns and payout sustainability.
